column3: “More abundantly” is rendered “much closer”; NASB supplies “from it.”
“Having neglected” is rendered as a condition, “if we neglect”; “having received a commencement” is rendered “After it was at the first spoken.”
The quotation is in capitals; “are mindful” is rendered “remember,” and “care for” “are concerned about.”
“A little” is rendered “for a little while.” NASB includes “and have appointed him over the works of your hands,” which is in the Textus Receptus but not in the critical text.
“A little” is rendered “for a little while”; NASB adds “namely.”
“Of one” is rendered “from one Father,” supplying “Father”; “brothers” is rendered “brethren.”
“I will be already trusting” is rendered “I will put my trust.”
“Blood and flesh” is rendered “flesh and blood,” and “destroy” “render powerless.”
“Through all their living” is rendered “all their lives.”
“It was necessary” is rendered “He had to,” and “brothers” “brethren.”
